Assign Developer: SYS:Developer
MakeDir RAM:CEFProfile
Assign PROFILE: RAM:CEFProfile
Stack 1048576
C:CEFClockContract
Echo CEF-clock-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
C:CEFOomCallback
Echo CEF-oom-callback-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Assign AROSTCP: SYS:System/Network/AROSTCP
Run <NIL: >RAM:AROSTCP-startup.log QUIET AROSTCP:C/AROSTCP
C:WaitForPort AROSTCP
Run >RAM:CEF-host.log Execute S:CEFHost-Run
C:CEFHostProbe wait
Run >RAM:CEF-appA.log Execute S:CEF-AppA
Wait 3
Run >RAM:CEF-appB.log Execute S:CEF-AppB
Wait 60
C:CEFHostProbe stats
Wait 60
C:CEFHostProbe stats
Type RAM:CEF-host.log >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostProbe stop
Type RAM:CEF-appA.log >DEBUG:
Type RAM:CEF-appB.log >DEBUG:
Echo Shared-browser-test-finished
Wait 3600
